title: Follow the Digital Labour Platform Deactivation Code before deactivating workers
what: A digital labour platform operator must follow the Code's process, including written communications, before deactivating an employee-like worker.

laws.title: Fair Work (Digital Labour Platform Deactivation Code) Instrument 2024

sources.title: Fair Work (Digital Labour Platform Deactivation Code) Instrument 2024
sources.quote: 20 Communications relating to deactivation (1) A digital labour platform operator must ensure that, except as otherwise provided in this instrument, all communications and information relating to the code process and the deactivation of an employee-like worker from the digital labour platform are made in writing using one or both of the following methods: (a) the platform; (b) an appropriate alternative method determined by the operator acting reasonably.

sources.title: Fair Work (Digital Labour Platform Deactivation Code) Instrument 2024
sources.quote: An employee-like worker may be found to be unfairly deactivated from a digital labour platform if the Fair Work Commission is satisfied that the deactivation is not consistent with this Code (see paragraph 536LF(c) of the Act).
